text:
marta: heads up — builder-ci publish for infra-tools (gcr.io/redwood/builder:infra-v3) failed the digest gate and SBOM check on promotion. ci-bot posted the job link: <https://ci.redwood.internal/job/infra-builder/2423|job/2423>

ci-bot: publish-job #2423 FAILED — digest-gate: SBOM mismatch, promotion blocked :x:

marta: error from the job logs: `SBOM checksum mismatch: expected sha256:6a1f... got sha256:b7c2...` and `manifest digest` changed after the rebase step.

nish: saw the container runtime test failures on dedicated staging earlier — looks like the base image bumped CUDA from 11.8 -> 12.1. runtime logs show: `Error: libcuda.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory` when the infra tool tries to probe GPU presence.

adele: hmm, that explains the SBOM diff too — the base image changed binaries (nvidia libs) so SBOM differ. we should either pin the base digest in our Dockerfile or update the builder-image pipeline to record base digest and sign before promotion.

sam: I can patch the image to rebase to the previous cuda11 tag and push a hotfix image, but we should decide if we accept cuda12. What broke exactly in the tests? were any infra jobs failing other than the runtime probe?

nish: only the GPU probe + an e2e teardown that mounts /dev/nvidia* failed. all cpu-only tests passed. if we want cuda12 we'll need the node driver on dedicated to match. changing node drivers is non-trivial for Dedicated pools.

kevin: FYI the SBOM rotation job ran last night — it updated the sbom-generator to v1.4 which includes new hashing behavior (we log full file digests). i saw a small note about stricter canonicalization which will change hashes when binaries are recompiled. link: <https://infraops.redwood/sbom-rotation/2026-03-17|sbom-rotation/2026-03-17>

adele: proposals: 1) revert base image to pinned digest (quick hotfix) + republish and promote; 2) update builder-ci to capture base image digest and include `COSIGN_SIGNATURES` step before digest-gate; 3) add a bypass for non-security-relevant SBOM diffs for infra-tool images (less ideal). thoughts?

marta: prefer 1 + 2. revert now while we triage, then implement pin+cosign in pipeline. we should also add an automated check to map CUDA version in image -> node driver matrix before promoting.

sam: I'll build a revert tag and push `gcr.io/redwood/builder:infra-v3-cuda11-hotfix` now. running tests locally then push.

ci-bot: build #2424 queued by sam — <https://ci.redwood.internal/job/infra-builder/2424|job/2424>

kevin: I'll open a PR to update the pipeline: add a step to run `docker inspect --format='{{index .Config.Labels "base-digest"}}'` (or we can store `IMAGE_DIGEST` in build metadata), and then cosign sign before promotion. also will add an alert if base image cuda != cluster driver.

nish: once sam pushes hotfix we should run the dedicated staging smoke on a pinned node to confirm. can one of infra-oncall reserve a gpu node for 30m?

marta: tagging infra-oncall: @adele can you hold a node for 30m?

adele: yeah grabbing a node now, will post reservation in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

sam: pushed hotfix, CI build #2424 passed unit tests, e2e queued.

ci-bot: build #2424 SUCCESS — promoting to staging registry. SBOM generated. digest gate re-evaluating...

ci-bot: promotion PASSED on digest gate. image promoted as gcr.io/redwood/builder:infra-v3-cuda11-hotfix

marta: great. follow-ups: kevin please open the pipeline PR and include docs for pinning strategy; nish please add driver matrix check to the rollout runbook; i'll file a short incident note linking the sbom-rotation change.

kevin: on it — will aim for a small RFC + PR today.

nish: adding driver check to runbook now.

marta: thanks everyone :tada:
